usedFor: Assinafy is a signature platform with its own workspaces; Docusign has workspaces too. When “New Workspace Created” in Assinafy fires, “Create Workspace” in Docusign can open a matching one so both sides stay organised the same way.

bestTemplate.name: “New Workspace Created” in Assinafy, then “Create Workspace” in Docusign
bestTemplate.why: It mirrors each new Assinafy workspace into Docusign automatically. “Update Workspace” is for renames, so it adds less.

watchOut: “New Workspace Created” polls within a set interval, so the mirror lags slightly. “Update Workspace” only changes a name or description, so it suits renames, not brand-new workspaces.
